scripts.build:packages: yarn workspace @prediction-indexer/read-only-object-store build && yarn workspace @prediction-indexer/rust-v1-decoder build
scripts.build: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace prediction-indexer-targeter-ui build
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json eslint.config.mjs archive/node encoder/node targeter-ui
scripts.lint: prettier --check package.json eslint.config.mjs archive/node encoder/node targeter-ui && eslint archive/node encoder/node targeter-ui
scripts.lint:fix: prettier --write package.json eslint.config.mjs archive/node encoder/node targeter-ui && eslint archive/node encoder/node targeter-ui --fix
scripts.test: yarn build:packages && yarn workspaces run test && yarn test:codec-integration
scripts.test:codec-integration: CARGO_BIN="$(command -v cargo || printf '%s' "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo")"; "$CARGO_BIN" build --manifest-path encoder/rust/Cargo.toml --bin prediction-decode-v1 && PREDICTION_DECODER_TEST_BINARY="$PWD/encoder/rust/target/debug/prediction-decode-v1" yarn workspace @prediction-indexer/rust-v1-decoder test:integration
